name: Can You Eat Meat
overview: Scripture reveals that God initially granted humanity permission to eat all living creatures as food, as seen in Genesis 9:3. However, specific dietary laws were later given through Moses, including prohibitions against consuming abominable things (Deuteronomy 14:3) and detailed instructions from the LORD (Leviticus 11:1). Jesus clarified that what enters a person from outside does not defile them (Mark 7:18), indicating a shift in the understanding of dietary restrictions. This teaching is further exemplified in Acts 10:9, where Peter's experience signals the unfolding of God's will regarding clean and unclean foods.
